values.note: RVs $50 a night, $300 a week, $900 a month plus electric; seasonal sites $3,600 plus electric for 5.5 months. One rate for everyone (no resident discount posted). Rates cover two adults and their children under 16; extra adults and children 16+ are $5 per person per night. Tents $25 (rustic area only).

fees.source: https://cityofmontague.org/trailway-campground/rates-rules/ (page updated 2026-08-18; Rates: RVs Daily $50, Weekly $300, Monthly '$900 + electric'; TENTS $25; 'Seasonal RV sites are $3,600 + electric (5.5 months)'; 'Rates are based on two adults and their children under age 16. Extra adults and/or children age 16 and over are charged $5 per person per night.'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://cityofmontague.org/trailway-campground/rates-rules/ ('City water, sewer, and electric available at all sites except site #21. Site #21 is a water and electric only site.'; '30/50/110 electric service.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: No tent sites (small tents in the rustic area as space allows). The 2024 campground map marks pull-through and back-in sites and about 30 seasonal sites. One RV and one vehicle per site; sites are assigned by management.

sites.source: https://cityofmontague.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/trailway_campground_map_v20240613.pdf (legend 'P - T (Pull Through Site)', 'B - I (Back In Site)', '* Seasonal Sites'; seven sites marked P-T, ~30 marked *) + https://cityofmontague.org/trailway-campground/rates-rules/ ('THERE ARE NO TENT SITES AVAILABLE AT TRAILWAY CAMPGROUND'; 'Only one RV and one vehicle permitted per site'; 'Management reserves the exclusive right to assign sites'; 'Big rigs welcome!'), read 2026-10-25. The derived count 55 and max 65 ft are not stated on the city pages and are left as they were.

values.note: Dump station free to campers ($20 to non-campers). Wireless internet at the sites for registered campers. Communal fire pit and pavilion with wood provided; no campfires at sites (portable propane fire pits allowed).

facilities.source: https://cityofmontague.org/trailway-campground/rates-rules/ ('Clean, modern restrooms and hot showers'; 'Dumping station (free to campers). $20 fee to non-campers'; 'High speed wireless internet at sites for registered campers'; 'Central common fire pit and pavilion with wood provided by city – No campfires allowed at sites'; 'Portable propane fire pits are permitted at your site.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reservations recommended: request one by phone (231-894-4903) or email (campground@cityofmontague.org), giving dates, RV type and length; email only in the off-season (Oct 15 - May 1). A deposit of half the camping fee is due within 7 days; cancellations more than 14 days out are refunded less a $30 processing fee, later ones forfeit the deposit. Specific sites are not guaranteed.

booking.source: https://cityofmontague.org/trailway-campground/rates-rules/ ('Reservations are recommended. You can contact the Trailway Campground Office by phone (231-894-4903) or email ... to request a reservation. Please provide arrival date, departure date, RV type, and RV length'; 'All correspondence and reservations during the offseason (October 15 to May 1) should be made by email'; deposit 1/2 within 7 days; 'Cancellations received more than 14 days prior to date of arrival will receive a full refund of the deposit minus a $30 processing fee'; 'We do not guarantee a specific site'), read 2026-10-25

note: City of Montague campground on Business 31 between Montague and Whitehall, across the street from White Lake and beside the White River, the World's Largest Weathervane and the paved Hart-Montague bike trail; an easy walk to both downtowns. No boats or boat trailers overnight in the campground (paid parking in the adjacent city lot, arranged with the manager). About 30 of the roughly 55 sites are seasonal (2024 campground map). --Claude
summary: City of Montague pages (rates page updated 2026-08-18) + 2024 campground map: $50/night (confirmed, 2026; one rate, no resident discount posted; +$5/person past two adults), 30/50-amp full hookups at all sites but #21 (confirmed), wifi (confirmed) + showers, flush toilets, dump; season May 1 - Oct 15 (new); reservable by phone/email with a half deposit (new); pull-throughs (new). Count 55 and max 65 ft (derived) not stated by the city, left. Phone and website match. Seasonal share: ~30 of ~55 sites marked seasonal, so roughly 25 (~45%) sell nights - passes the 1-in-10 test; no minimum stay. Note trimmed of field restatements and the unconfirmed cable TV.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (weak): the city page says 'Trailway Campground is adjacent to the White River' and 'across the street from beautiful White Lake' (map shows a fishing bridge); the entry has 'not waterfront'.
